verdict.rationale: Zep's core knowledge-graph engine, Graphiti, is explicitly open source and hosted on GitHub with community acknowledgment of the open-sourcing, but the main Zep product (cloud service, API server, zepctl CLI) is a commercial offering with no evidence its source is published. Missing for 10: confirmation of an open license for the Zep platform itself (not just the Graphiti library), visible LICENSE file details, and independent corroboration of the license terms.
